```artifact
## UML Testing Profile (UTP)

**Test Suite Name:** U06_2_Lab_Management_System

**Description:** This suite tests the functionalities of the Lab Management System.

**Target Application:** Lab Management System

**Target Platform:** Heroku with Ver. 5.7.21 MySQL Database

**Target Users:** Lab Incharge, Chemist, Admin, Patient

**Test Cases:**

| ID | Title | Requirement ID(s) | Kind | Preconditions | Inputs | Steps | Expected |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-001 | Lab Incharge can perform lab tests | VIRTUA-2.3-13 | Positive | Lab Incharge is logged in | Test sample | Perform lab test | Test result is generated and stored |
| TC-002 | Lab Incharge can update reports offline | VIRTUA-2.3-13 | Positive | Lab Incharge is logged in | Offline mode | Update report | Report is updated successfully |
| TC-003 | Lab Incharge can update reports online | VIRTUA-2.3-13 | Positive | Lab Incharge is logged in | Online mode | Update report | Report is updated successfully |
| TC-004 | Lab Incharge can set flag in prescription | VIRTUA-2.3-13 | Positive | Lab Incharge is logged in | Prescription | Set flag | Flag is set in prescription |
| TC-005 | System is deployed on Heroku platform | VIRTUA-2.4-1 | Positive | N/A | N/A | N/A | System is deployed on Heroku platform with Ver. 5.7.21 MySQL Database |
| TC-006 | System is accessed via Hospital website | VIRTUA-2.4-2 | Positive | N/A | N/A | N/A | System is accessible via Hospital website |
| TC-007 | System supports multiple browsers | VIRTUA-2.4-2 | Positive | N/A | N/A | N/A | System supports Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, etc. |
| TC-008 | System can print and store invoices and reports | VIRTUA-2.4-4 | Positive | N/A | N/A | N/A | Invoices and reports can be printed and stored |
| TC-009 | System prevents full scan of Patient Consultation Request Entity | VIRTUA-2.5-1 | Negative | N/A | N/A | Perform full scan of Patient Consultation Request Entity | System prevents full scan |

```
